DRAFT 2026-09-07, not yet confirmed by Vincent: every unit figure marked confirm:true is to be checked against the approved program requirements and the current LBCC-GE sheet before this ships. The AI courses come from the content collection; program.json holds the ladder and the supporting courses.

sources.text: LBCC program narrative for the A.S. in Artificial Intelligence for Digital Transformation (Regional CTE listing): the six AI courses, CS 31 (3), COSP 38 (4) and COSN 250 (3), subtotal 28 units; then LBCC-GE, CSU GE Breadth or IGETC/Cal-GETC, plus electives as needed to reach 60 degree-applicable units.
LBCC-GE 2025–2026 advising sheet: general education must total 25 units for the A.A. or 19 units for the A.S.

Title 5 §55063 (effective Fall 2025): local GE pattern of seven areas, 21 semester units minimum: English Composition; Oral Communication and Critical Thinking; Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning; Arts and Humanities; Social and Behavioral Sciences; Natural Sciences; Ethnic Studies.
LBCC online catalog (current requirements, course descriptions, GE course lists).

supporting.title: Introduction to Computer Science – Python
supporting.note: The program narrative lists 3 units; the LBCC class schedule shows CS 31 at 4 units. Confirm which applies to the degree.

ge.unitsNote: Seven areas, one course each, 3 units minimum per area (21 units). The 2025–26 LBCC-GE sheet states 19 units for an A.S.; confirm the current total with Counseling. CSU GE Breadth or Cal-GETC may be used instead for students planning to transfer.

areas.name: Oral Communication and Critical Thinking
areas.example: COMM C1000 Introduction to Public Speaking

areas.name: Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning
areas.note: Statistics pairs well with AI 40; also satisfies the mathematics proficiency.

areas.name: Arts and Humanities
areas.example: an introductory philosophy, art history or literature course

areas.name: Natural Sciences
areas.example: an introductory biology, earth or physical science course

electives.note: Any degree-applicable LBCC courses bring the total to 60 units. Focus-area electives recommended by the program (for example web development or business process automation) are to be confirmed from the approved program documents.

degreePlan.title: Full-time, four semesters
degreePlan.note: About 15 units a term. At half that load the same plan takes eight semesters; the order stays the same. AI courses go in the recommended order, the supporting courses sit beside the AI course they help most, and one general-education course each term keeps the load balanced.

semesters.name: Semester 1
semesters.milestone: AI Literacy (Certificate of Accomplishment, 6 units) earned

semesters.name: Semester 2
semesters.milestone: AI Fluency (Certificate of Achievement, 12 units) earned

semesters.name: Semester 4
semesters.milestone: AI for Digital Transformation (Certificate of Achievement, 18 units) and the A.S. degree earned

certificatePlans.note: Both courses can be taken in the same term; neither has a prerequisite.
AI 60 and AI 65 may be taken in either order, or together.
AI 80 (the capstone) recommends AI 70 first. A student in a hurry can take AI 70 and AI 80 in the same term, since recommended preparation is advisory, and finish in three semesters.
